legend: Given a board of size N×N$$$N \times N$$$, where each cell can be alive, dead, or uninhabitable, simulate the evolution of the board for K$$$K$$$ iterations based on the following rules:
∙$$$\bullet$$$ A live cell ('1'$$$\texttt{'1'}$$$) dies if it has an odd number of live neighbors.
∙$$$\bullet$$$ A dead cell ('0'$$$\texttt{'0'}$$$) becomes alive if it has an odd number of live neighbors.
∙$$$\bullet$$$ An uninhabitable cell ('#'$$$\texttt{'#'}$$$) never changes state and is never considered alive.
Each cell has up to 8 neighbors (horizontal, vertical, and diagonal).
Your goal is to determine the final state of the board after K$$$K$$$ iterations.
input: The first line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ and K$$$K$$$ (2≤N≤8$$$2 \leq N \leq 8$$$, 1≤K≤109$$$1 \leq K \leq 10^9$$$) — the size of the board and the number of iterations.
The next N$$$N$$$ lines contain N$$$N$$$ characters each, describing the initial state of the board.
Let Si,j$$$S_{i,j}$$$ be the character in the i$$$i$$$-th row and j$$$j$$$-th column:
∙$$$\bullet$$$ Si,j='1'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'1'}$$$ if the cell is alive,
∙$$$\bullet$$$ Si,j='0'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'0'}$$$ if the cell is dead,
∙$$$\bullet$$$ Si,j='#'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'#'}$$$ if the cell is uninhabitable.
output: Print N$$$N$$$ lines, each containing N$$$N$$$ characters, representing the final state of the board after K$$$K$$$ iterations.

legend.ai: 给定一个大小为 N×N$$$N \times N$$$ 的棋盘，其中每个单元格可以是活的、死的或不可居住的，请根据以下规则模拟棋盘经过 K$$$K$$$ 次迭代后的演化：
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 一个活细胞('1'$$$\texttt{'1'}$$$)在其存活邻居数量为奇数时会死亡。
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 一个死细胞('0'$$$\texttt{'0'}$$$)在其存活邻居数量为奇数时会复活。
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 不可居住的单元格('#'$$$\texttt{'#'}$$$)永远不会改变状态，也永远不会被视为存活。
每个单元格最多有 8 个邻居（水平、垂直以及对角线方向的邻居）。
你的目标是在经过 K$$$K$$$ 次迭代后确定棋盘的最终状态。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 K$$$K$$$(2≤N≤8$$$2 \leq N \leq 8$$$，1≤K≤109$$$1 \leq K \leq 10^9$$$)——棋盘的大小和迭代次数。
接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行每行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个字符，用于描述棋盘的初始状态。
令 Si,j$$$S_{i,j}$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 行、第 j$$$j$$$ 列中的字符：
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 如果该格中的细胞存活，则 Si,j='1'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'1'}$$$
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 如果该格中的细胞死亡，则 Si,j='0'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'0'}$$$
∙$$$\bullet$$$ 如果该格不可居住，则 Si,j='#'$$$S_{i,j} = \texttt{'#'}$$$

output.ai: 输出 N$$$N$$$ 行，每行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个字符，表示经过 K$$$K$$$ 次迭代后棋盘的最终状态。
